issues.current_text: Google lançou o Gemini Embedding 2, primeiro modelo de embedding nativamente multimodal que unifica texto, imagem, vídeo e áudio.
issues.previous_text: Gemini Embedding 2, o primeiro modelo de embedding nativamente multimodal da empresa, que mapeia texto, imagens, vídeo, áudio e documentos em um espaço unificado com redução de latência de até 70%
issues.suggestion: Cut entirely. This exact product was already covered two days ago with more detail. Readers will recognize it immediately.

issues.current_text: A Databricks lançou o Genie Code, agente autônomo para engenharia de dados com taxa de sucesso de 77,1% vs. 32,1% dos concorrentes, e simultaneamente adquiriu a Quotient AI para avaliação contínua.
issues.previous_text: Databricks lançou o Genie Code, agente autônomo para dados que mais que dobrou a taxa de sucesso de agentes de código existentes — de 32,1% para 77,1%.
issues.suggestion: Cut the Genie Code mention — it's the same product with the same stats from two days ago. The Quotient AI acquisition could be mentioned standalone if newsworthy enough, but don't re-introduce Genie Code.

issues.current_text: AI-Q da NVIDIA conquistou primeiro lugar em ambos os DeepResearch Bench com um stack aberto baseado no Nemotron-3-Super de 120B — treinado em 67.000 trajetórias em ~25 horas em 16x8 H100s
issues.previous_text: A Nvidia liberou o Nemotron 3 Super, modelo aberto de 120 bilhões de parâmetros totais com apenas 12 bilhões ativos — uma arquitetura híbrida Mamba-Transformer com MoE que entrega 5x mais throughput e janela nativa de 1M tokens
issues.suggestion: The AI-Q benchmark win is new, but Nemotron-3-Super was yesterday's lead AI story. Reframe to focus on the AI-Q system and benchmark result without re-explaining the model. A brief 'built on the Nemotron-3-Super released yesterday' is enough context.

issues.current_text: Brent cruzou $100/barril — alta de 50% em um mês
issues.previous_text: Brent oscila em torno de $100 com 7,5% da oferta global comprometida.
issues.suggestion: Brent was already described as 'around $100' yesterday. The 'crossing $100' framing suggests a new milestone, but readers saw $100 yesterday. Either acknowledge it was already at that level or focus on the 50% monthly increase as the real stat.

issues.current_text: O detalhe: Khamenei não apareceu em câmera (...) O detalhe revelador: executivos discutiram licenciar tecnologia do Gemini
issues.suggestion: The 'O detalhe:' / 'O detalhe revelador:' device appears twice in a single edition. Use it at most once per issue. Replace one with a different transition — e.g., 'O que chamou atenção:', 'Por trás dos números:', or simply integrate the detail into the sentence without the label.

issues.current_text: captou $200 milhões numa Série A liderada pela Menlo Ventures a $1,6 bilhão de valuation (...) captou $500 milhões em Série A liderada por Accel e a16z a $2 bilhões de valuation (...) captou $165 milhões a $1,15 bilhão (...) captou $50 milhões da Benchmark
issues.previous_text: captou $400 milhões numa Série D que avalia a empresa em $9 bilhões (03-12) / levantou $1,1 bilhão a $8,1 bilhões de valuation (03-11) / fechou uma seed de US$ 1,03 bilhão com valuation de US$ 3,5 bilhões (03-10)
issues.suggestion: The 'captou $X milhões/bilhões' + valuation formula appears 4 times in today's draft alone and has been used in every previous edition. Vary the construction: 'levantou', 'fechou rodada de', 'recebeu aporte de', or restructure some sentences to lead with the product/mission rather than the dollar figure.

issues.current_text: o maior investimento early-stage da história da robótica
issues.previous_text: a maior liberação coordenada de petróleo da história (03-11) / a maior da história europeia (03-10)
issues.suggestion: Every edition uses 'da história' as a superlative qualifier. When everything is 'the biggest in history,' nothing is. Reserve the phrase for truly exceptional cases (once per edition max) or find alternatives: 'sem precedentes', 'recorde', or let the numbers speak for themselves.

issues.current_text: a corrida pela interconexão óptica acelera em paralelo com a demanda por compute
issues.previous_text: A corrida de robotáxis ganha escala em três continentes
issues.suggestion: The 'race/corrida' + 'accelerates/gains scale' framing has appeared recently. Drop the 'corrida' metaphor or be more specific about what's actually accelerating — e.g., name the competing standards or cite deployment timelines.

issues.current_text: Structure: Iran/war section → AI/tech section → funding rounds → hardware/robotics → biotech/health → closing item
issues.previous_text: Same structural pattern across all four editions: geopolitics → AI models/launches → funding → hardware → biotech/health
issues.suggestion: The newsletter follows the same section order every day. Consider occasionally leading with the strongest non-war story, or interleaving topics by narrative connection rather than category. Readers who skim will notice the identical structure.

summary: Two direct story repeats (Gemini Embedding 2, Databricks Genie Code — both from 03-11) must be cut. Nemotron reference needs trimming. Phrasing ('O detalhe', 'captou $X') and superlative framing ('da história') are becoming tics. Moderate repetition level overall — 6 of ~12 stories are original.
